items.title: 13-Week Cash Flow
items.summary: See the next 13 weeks of cash, week by week, so you spot the week money runs short before it happens.
howTo: Set up: type the cash in your bank today, the Monday your week 1 starts, and the least cash you want on hand.
Cash in: for each week, type only money you expect to land that week. Invoices count the week they get paid, not the week you send them.
Cash out: fill each line you pay. Leave a line blank if it doesn't apply.
Read Cash position. Any week under your cushion turns red.
Read What it says. Fix the lowest week first: move a cost, ask for a deposit, or chase a payment.
Every Monday, type what really happened in last week's column and add a new week at the end.
items.output: Your cash position for each of the next 13 weeks, the lowest week, and how many weeks dip under your cushion.

items.title: Unit Economics

prompts.title: Cash runway and spending check
prompts.when: You want to know how long your money lasts and which costs to cut first.

prompts.title: Quote and invoice writer
prompts.when: A customer said yes or asked for a price, and you need a clean quote or invoice now.

items.groupTitle: Finance and forecasting: know your numbers

items.title: Offer prompts
items.summary: A good offer does the selling for you. These prompts build an offer, a free lead magnet, a price ladder and a sales page that people find hard to say no to, without hype

prompts.title: Offer builder
prompts.when: You know what you do and who for, and you want an offer that is easy to say yes to.

prompts.title: A free thing that feels dumb to give away
prompts.when: You need a lead magnet people actually want: so useful they wonder why it is free.

prompts.title: Price ladder and money model
prompts.when: You have one offer and want the full path: a way in, a main offer, an upgrade, a smaller option, and a monthly plan.

prompts.title: What should I charge?
prompts.when: You're about to quote a price and you're guessing.

prompts.title: Sales page that converts
prompts.when: You need a landing or sales page for your offer, written so a stranger understands it in five seconds.

prompts.title: Objection bank
prompts.when: Before sales calls or DMs, so you never freeze when someone pushes back.

items.groupTitle: Offer: make it too good to ignore

items.title: Ops and SOPs prompts
items.summary: A business is only worth what it is when you are not there. These prompts plan your day, write your processes down, find what to automate, and turn repeat work into a

prompts.title: Do my day
prompts.when: Every morning. Paste your list, pipeline and calendar and get the exact order to do things in.

prompts.title: Write the SOP
prompts.when: You do something more than twice. Write it down once so you, a helper or your AI can do it the same way every time.

prompts.title: What should I automate?
prompts.when: You feel busy but not productive. You want to know which jobs to automate, template, delegate or drop.

prompts.title: Turn a repeat job into an AI skill
prompts.when: You keep giving your AI the same instructions. Package them once as a reusable skill, project, or custom GPT.

prompts.title: Client onboarding kit
prompts.when: You just closed a customer and want them to feel taken care of from minute one.

prompts.title: Weekly CEO review
prompts.when: Once a week, 20 minutes. Step out of the work and steer the business.

prompts.title: First helper brief
prompts.when: You're ready to pay someone for a few hours a week and want the job clear before you post it.

items.groupTitle: Ops and SOPs: run it without you in every step

items.title: Outreach prompts
items.summary: Every business starts with the first 25 people who might buy. These prompts help you build that list, show each one something useful, write the message, follow up, and

prompts.title: Build your list of 25
prompts.when: You know what you sell and need a list of real people or businesses to contact first, with a reason to contact each one.

prompts.title: First message with a sample attached
prompts.when: You have someone on your list and a gap you noticed. You want a first message that gets read, not ignored.

prompts.title: Follow-up sequence
prompts.when: Someone didn't reply. Most yeses come after the second or third touch.

prompts.title: Reply copilot
prompts.when: Someone replied and you want the best next message, fast.

prompts.title: Call prep in 60 seconds
prompts.when: You have a sales call coming up and want a plan for it.

prompts.title: Comment-to-DM automation script
prompts.when: You post content and want people who comment a keyword to get your free thing by DM automatically (ManyChat or similar).

prompts.title: Warm network and referral asks
prompts.when: Before cold outreach. The people who already know you are the fastest first customers and referrals.

prompts.title: Brand pitch for creators
prompts.when: You're a UGC creator or influencer and want to pitch brands for paid content.

items.groupTitle: Outreach: find buyers and start conversations

items.title: Review prompts
items.summary: Most first drafts are fine. Fine loses. Run these on anything before it goes out: an offer, a page, a script, a plan. They find what is generic, unclear or untrue, and

prompts.title: The 10x pass
prompts.when: You (or your AI) finished something and it is "good enough". Run this before you ship it.

prompts.title: Is this high quality or AI filler?
prompts.when: Anything an AI helped make. Catch the generic, robotic or padded parts before a customer does.

prompts.title: Five-second clarity test
prompts.when: Before you publish a page, post, ad or pitch. If a stranger can't get it in five seconds, it fails.

prompts.title: Brand consistency sweep
prompts.when: You have made a lot of things fast (posts, pages, emails, decks) and want them to look and sound like one brand.

prompts.title: Claims and compliance check
prompts.when: Before any ad, sales page, email or post goes out. Catch promises that could get you in trouble or lose trust.

prompts.title: Red-team it as a skeptical buyer
prompts.when: Before a pitch, launch or price change. Hear every reason to say no before a real buyer says it.

prompts.title: Pre-mortem
prompts.when: Before you commit time or money to a launch, hire, tool or big change.

items.title: Start prompts
items.summary: Use these before you build anything. They test an idea against real demand, find who already sells it, and get you talking to buyers this week.

prompts.title: The Idea Test
prompts.when: You have one to five business ideas and want a straight answer on which one to start, before you spend a dollar.

prompts.title: Business match
prompts.when: You want to start something but don't have an idea yet, and you want three options that fit your skills, time and money.

prompts.title: Five-player teardown
prompts.when: You picked a business and want to know how the people already winning at it find buyers, price, and deliver.

prompts.title: Customer interview kit
prompts.when: Before you build. You want to learn how buyers solve the problem today and whether they would pay you to solve it.

prompts.title: Market research brief
prompts.when: You need the numbers and trends behind a market fast: size, growth, buyers, prices, and where AI is changing it.

prompts.title: Demand check
prompts.when: You've had some sales or conversations and want an honest read on whether people really want this, and what to double down on.

items.groupTitle: Start: pick it and prove it

items.title: Video prompts
items.summary: Video sells. These prompts write scripts, plan shoots, write prompts for AI video and voice tools, build an edit plan, and make a spec video to pitch a business before

prompts.title: Short video script
prompts.when: You have a topic and need a 15 to 60 second script that hooks, keeps people watching and ends with one action.

prompts.title: Spec promo video for a prospect
prompts.when: You want to pitch a local business by showing them a video made for them before they've paid you.

prompts.title: AI video shot prompts
prompts.when: You want B-roll, product shots or scenes from an AI video tool and need prompts that come out right the first time.

prompts.title: Voiceover script and voice direction
prompts.when: You want a voiceover for a video, read by you or an AI voice tool.

prompts.title: Edit plan from raw footage
prompts.when: You have raw clips and need a fast plan to cut them into a short video in CapCut or any editor.

prompts.title: Long video outline
prompts.when: You want to make a 5 to 15 minute YouTube or podcast-style video that builds trust and sends people to your offer.

items.groupTitle: Video: script, shoot, generate and edit

items.title: Website and store prompts
items.summary: A site that looks cheap costs you buyers. These prompts build animated landing pages, steal good ideas from great sites, fix a weak hero, and launch a store that

prompts.title: Build an animated landing page
prompts.when: You want a real, working one-page site with motion that feels premium, built by an AI that writes code (Claude, ChatGPT, Replit, Lovable, v0).

prompts.title: Make the hero 10x better
prompts.when: Your homepage top section feels flat, generic or "AI". You want it to hook a stranger in five seconds.

prompts.title: Learn from a great site
prompts.when: You found a site, brand or studio you love and want to borrow what makes it great without copying it.

prompts.title: Homepage mock-up for a prospect
prompts.when: You sell websites and want to show a business what their new homepage could look like before they pay.

prompts.title: Store launch plan
prompts.when: You are opening a Shopify, Etsy or similar store and want it set up to sell from day one.

prompts.title: Why is my site not converting?
prompts.when: People visit but don't buy, book or sign up.

items.groupTitle: Website and store: look like the real thing
